titre: Le vieillissement va plus vite dans le Sud
sous_titre: Croissance de la population de 65 ans et plus, en %, avril 2020 à juillet 2025

Nord-Est.texte: The Northeast also had the fastest decline among ages 45-64 (-7.1%) and the slowest growth among those age 65 and older (14.6%).

Ensemble des États-Unis.texte: The 65-and-older population grew 16.2%, from 55.6 million to 64.6 million between April 2020 and July 2025.

Sud.texte: the only region whose 65-and-older population grew fastest at 17.5%
